definitions.explanation: An informal, emphatic word meaning extremely cheap or at a bargain price. Formed from 爆 (explosive) + 安 (cheap), suggesting prices so low they are shocking.

examples.japanese: このスマホは{爆安|ばくやす}だ。
{爆安|ばくやす}セールで{服|ふく}をたくさん{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a lot of clothes at the blowout sale.

examples.japanese: ネットで{爆安|ばくやす}の{航空券|こうくうけん}を{見|み}つけたので、すぐに{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I found insanely cheap plane tickets online, so I booked them right away.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, colloquial word commonly used in advertising, online shopping, and casual conversation. Part of the 爆〜 pattern where 爆 intensifies the following word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆安|ばくやす}セール (blowout sale)
- {爆安|ばくやす}{価格|かかく} (rock-bottom price)
- {爆安|ばくやす}で{買|か}う (to buy dirt cheap)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {激安|げきやす}: very cheap — similar meaning but slightly less emphatic
- {格安|かくやす}: bargain-priced — more neutral and widely used
